name: 에이치큐광안

crowding.note: 주말이나 라이브 공연, 트리비아 나이트 등 이벤트가 있는 날에는 붐비고 활기찬 분위기가 형성됨.

descriptors.audience: 외국인 및 현지 거주자, 광안리 방문 관광객

localVsTourist.note: 부산 거주 외국인(익스팻) 커뮤니티의 아지트이자 현지인과 관광객이 고루 찾는 펍 겸 바.

notes: 행정동/사업자등록 상호 '에이치큐광안'(HQ광안/HQ Bar Gwangan)으로, 광안해변로 237(테마타워 4층)에 위치한 광안대교 뷰의 펍/경양식 바입니다.

sourceExcerpts.excerpt: HQ Gwangan (often referred to as HQ Bar) is a popular, long-standing bar and community hub located on the beachfront of Gwangalli Beach in Busan, South Korea. It is well-known for its prime location overlooking Gwangalli Beach, offering stunning night views of the illuminated Gwangan Bridge. It is a popular hangout spot for the expat community and locals alike, known for a lively, social atmosphere. The bar serves a variety of drinks, including craft beers and cocktails, and Western-style pub food menu.

HQ Gwangan is a popular expat bar located on the beachfront of Gwangalli in Busan, known for its views of the Gwangan Bridge, craft beers, and Western-style pub food. Address: 237 Gwanganhaebyeon-ro, Suyeong-gu, Busan (4th floor). Hours: Monday Closed, Tue-Wed 19:00-24:00, Thu 19:00-01:00, Fri-Sat 19:00-03:00, Sun 17:00-24:00. Food includes burgers, pizza, wings, Mexican food (tacos), and macaroni & cheese.

whyPeopleGo.note: 광안리 해변과 광안대교 파노라마 뷰를 감상하며 수제 맥주와 웨스턴 펍 음식을 즐길 수 있는 소셜 허브이기 때문.
